description: Loop completion hook must invoke ecc-trace-wrap, not skip it
context: The loop completion hook is the entry point for the self-improvement flywheel. It must always run ecc-trace-wrap first.

description: Loop start hook must never auto-commit patches — only notify the user
must_not_contain: automatically applying patches without user approval
context: Loop hook only shows a readiness notification. The SKILL.md itself says 'NEVER auto-commits' which is correct. We only block patterns that say the opposite.

description: Loop hook must check BC-1 through BC-4 boundary conditions
context: Boundary conditions gate the readiness notification. All 4 must be checked.

description: Router must show TIER 2 gate before routing to ecc-self-improve (non-dry-run)
context: Any Tier 2+ self-improve invocation requires the router to load and display TERMS.md summary first.

description: Router must check LEARNINGS.md for known weaknesses before routing to a skill
context: Pre-flight warning shows the user what unpatched issues exist in the target skill before executing it.

description: Router must route 'preview patches' and 'dry run' to ecc-self-improve --dry-run
context: Dry run is the Tier 1 safe mode for previewing patches without applying them.

description: ecc-learn must attempt cm memory recall before aggregating LEARNINGS.md
context: Memory recall shows what happened in previous sessions before the user sees the current LEARNINGS aggregation.

description: ecc-learn must warn when entries are missing conversation_evidence
context: The Judge Gate in ecc-self-improve filters out entries without conversation_evidence. Users should know these won't be promoted.

description: Trace wrap must include conversation_evidence field in every JSON entry
context: Without conversation_evidence, entries are rejected by Stage 2b Judge Gate B.

description: Self-improve must run Stage 0 boundary check before any mining (non-dry-run)
context: Stage 0 is the first gate. It prevents premature execution when conditions are not yet met.
